crossRefs.note: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said…
and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.
“You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
For we are strangers before you, and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and…
“Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a…
I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having…
For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

people.name: Gershom
people.line: Son of Moses; father of Jonathan, a renegade priest.

translations.web: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.”
translations.bsb: And she gave birth to a son, and Moses named him Gershom, saying, “I have become a foreigner in a foreign land.”
translations.kjv: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
translations.asv: And she bare a son, and he called his name Gershom; for he said, I have been a sojourner in a foreign land.
